scope: Disposable synthetic localhost browser → actual FastAPI → SQLite. Actual fake-email invitation deliveries read only from ignored local mailbox. No request overrides, real emails or staging/production data.

scenarios.name: new account atomic browser onboarding creates one canonical linked person
same-key and existing identity retries leave no orphan family/person
actual owner invitation email is accepted only by its verified recipient
invited member creates only own canonical profile in the existing family
existing canonical identity needs explicit reuse consent after invitation
existing person claim waits for owner approval and persists after member reload
explicit parent relation has reciprocal tree views without ancestry inference
membership does not grant admin or cross-family private access
